body.name: Branch conditional ATT contrasts
body.construction:
Let \(\mu_{C,t}(x)=(\mu_{2,t}(x),\ldots,\mu_{J+1,t}(x))^{\prime}\). Define
\[
 C_{\mathrm{PT}}(x)=\mu_{1,T}(x)-\mu_{1,T-1}(x)-J^{-1}\mathbf 1_J^{\prime}D(x),
 \qquad
 C_{\mathrm{SC}}(x)=\mu_{1,T}(x)-w(x)^{\prime}\mu_{C,T}(x).
\]
For \(b\in\{\mathrm{PT},\mathrm{SC}\}\), write \(C_b(x)\) for the corresponding conditional contrast.
